description: From iPad to a laptop in just one click Neopack Folio takes mobile computing to a new level. Now you can enjoy laptop-like typing anywhere you take your iPad. Its slim, light design makes it a joy to use and carry around, all the while keeping your iPad safe from bumps, scratches, and spills. No matter where you need to get your work done - a cafe table, a desk or even your lap - Slim Folio locks your iPad at an optimal angle for typing and holds firm on any surface. Turn your tablet into a laptop Large well-spaced keys and a laptop-like layout make typing fast and comfortable. Dedicated function and shortcut keys give you control over your tablet without having to touch the screen. Switch between apps, bring up search, go to the Home screen, control volume or media right from the keyboard. * This Neopack delta 7PAD10 case image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. Type or Browse on your desk or lap Simply open the case and start typing. Your iPad is locked in the perfect typing position and stays firmly in place even when typing on uneven surfaces like your lap.
